events.title: Ambient events, new dialogues and bug fixes (Dev updates)
events.summary: Salutations Everyone! A new minor update with some major dialogue and other event changes as well as more setting options and new Ambient events occurring in the game. We cant put them here without spoilers but know most characters sounds better and some continuity errors are fixed! We should have a new update in a few days for the full game, a new harder game mode that the standard three that uses relationship decay, no longer can you neglect friends and expect them to like you as much! events.title: Music and Art update!
events.summary: Salutations!We have just added music and location art to the game. Each track can be volume adjusted and the old art can be brought back, both from the in-game esc menu!As a result we are keeping the Playtest going through next weekend so people can check it out if they want to!Granitefire Games

events.title: Hello World!
events.summary: Greetings everyone!This is our first game here on steam! Its a big milestone for a new developer. Our game is mostly complete just missing balancing and polishing!Anyways, we need playtesters! So if this seems like something you would be willing do, click the request access button on the main store page. It might take a few days for everything do get working properly with the playtest.
